packageRules.description: Composer constraint strings mirror the fresh Laravel reference and are changed only by the update-laravel-packages skill. Routine Renovate updates resolve the lockfile within those constraints; the deny rules below block update types that can leave the current caret ranges. Close any exceptional security PR that still edits composer.json and route it through the skill.
Group Composer minor and patch updates.
Group pnpm minor and patch updates through Renovate's npm manager.
Composer major updates go through the update-laravel-packages skill, which classifies provenance against a fresh Laravel reference before changing constraints.
Composer 0.x minor updates can fall outside caret constraints such as ^0.1; route those constraint changes through the update-laravel-packages skill.
Composer 0.0.x patch updates can fall outside caret constraints such as ^0.0.3; route those constraint changes through the update-laravel-packages skill.
Dependency replacements edit composer.json and therefore go through the update-laravel-packages skill instead of Renovate.
